== Title ==
<span lang="ja">探査部隊</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">1フォース消費して、相手の手札を10秒間見ること。反乱軍カードを見つけたなら、どれか1名を選んで相手のユーズドデッキの一番上に移動させることができる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">帝国軍は高感度な器材を使用して捕えた宇宙船の閉ざされた区画を探査する。探査部隊ＢＴ－445はミレニアム ファルコン号を調べようとした。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Scanning Crew]].

'''Lore''' — The Empire uses highly sensitive equipment to scan closed compartments of captured starships. Scanning crew BT-445 tried to inspect the Millennium Falcon.

'''Game text''' — Use 1 Force to look at the opponent's hand for 10 seconds. If you find Rebel cards, you may choose one and move it to the top of the opponent's Used Deck.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore scans closed compartments and says BT-445 tried to inspect the Falcon. Game text moves a Rebel card to the Used Deck. White border.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-scanningcrew.gif|Original English face]], [[Scanning Crew]].</ref>
